newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish bus crashes, twenty-five reported dead.
newsitem.headline: Turkish bus crashes, twenty-five reported dead.

text.p: Twenty-five people were reported to have died in a bus crash in eastern Turkey on Friday, Anatolian news agency and Turkish television said.
It said 18 people were believed to have been injured in the crash in the province of Erzincan. It gave no further details. Officials were not immediately available to confirm the report.
The private NTV television channel said the bus overturned into a ditch after failing to take a bend.
Seven of the casualties, taken to various hospitals in Erzincan and neighbouring Erzurum province, were reported to be badly injured.
